exposure_classes.semantics: default state (D3 O1); authorized internal research/evaluation only; never automatically learner-facing
exposure_classes.transition: enter from hidden after licensing/permitted-use classification (G1); default whenever qualification incomplete

exposure_classes.semantics: qualified internal diagnostic computation (D3 O2); not automatically displayable
exposure_classes.transition: enter from research_only only when ALL O2 gates G1-G7 pass

exposure_classes.semantics: explicit display-policy qualification; descriptive/non-normative language only
exposure_classes.transition: enter from diagnostic_only only via explicit D-08 display policy + licensing/anonymization gate; unpopulated in this Goal

exposure_classes.semantics: internal pipeline only; intermediate computation states
exposure_classes.transition: initial class for newly produced aggregates; must resolve before use

exposure_classes.semantics: fail closed; never fabricated or substituted (I4)
exposure_classes.transition: terminal for unqualified/unknown/inadmissible artifacts; no widening

exposure_rules: research_only is the default for every corpus-derived artifact; qualification incomplete means O1
diagnostic_only is a computation class, not a display class
displayable requires Researcher decision + display policy + licensing/anonymization gate (D-08)
downgrade always permitted; upgrade requires gate evidence (D-09)
unavailable is terminal for that artifact version
anonymization_requirements: P1 aggregate-only content: min-N 30 effective and complete-case N >= 30; no per-document text or per-learner records
P2 no raw text, excerpts, examples, paraphrases, or reconstructive derivatives in any artifact
P3 no corpus paths or handles in artifacts or machine records (ADR-06)
P4 no PII propagation; no identifiers that re-identify corpus documents beyond registered provenance document_ids
P5 learner text never written into corpus (I2); numeric snapshots stay outside git
P6 no cross-domain leakage; same-domain predicate; domain-scoped export default (D-19)
P7 missingness and uncertainty exposed, never hidden behind false precision
P8 anonymization gate required before any displayable class
P9 internal descriptive reporting only; no external redistribution or public release

epistemic_layers.meaning: observed feature value; reference comparison within declared group
diagnostic inference from verified evidence through a declared gate
epistemic_layers.prohibited: trait attribution; claim that a gated signal measures an ability

epistemic_layers.meaning: feedback recommendation; LEARNER-owned via FeedbackPolicy; corpus contributes evidence only
epistemic_layers.prohibited: outcome/ability claim attached to a recommendation

epistemic_layers.meaning: learning outcome; reserved; validated measurement models only

admissibility_mapping.meaning: all record fields correct; versions match; group eligible; no validity flags; no fallback
admissibility_mapping.exposure_consequence: eligible for diagnostic_only qualification with all O2 gates

admissibility_mapping.meaning: admissible with validity flags, fragile group, or fallback disclosure
admissibility_mapping.exposure_consequence: usable descriptively with disclosure and limitation attached; never presented without them
maps to exposure class unavailable; no widening or substitution

admissibility_mapping.meaning: prohibited use (normative wording, cross-version, 270-block circularity, score fields, ungated learner exposure, silent defaults, imputed missingness, missing disclosure)
admissibility_mapping.exposure_consequence: never usable; excluded from any diagnostic computation

qualification_gates.criterion: named consumer + authorization: consuming capability (LEARNER foundation) declared; Goal authorization covers diagnostic use
qualification_gates.evidence: goal packet/authorization record; named consumer in contract record

qualification_gates.criterion: permitted-use/licensing classification: artifact class NON-RECONSTRUCTIVE AGGREGATE; internal research-pipeline category permitted

qualification_gates.evidence: privacy review record attached to artifact

qualification_gates.criterion: evidence-admissibility: ADMISSIBLE or LIMITED-with-disclosure; never UNAVAILABLE/INVALID
D-08 display-policy compatibility: exposure class assigned; canonical claim templates; no normative labels; banned vocabulary absent
diagnostic-contract qualification: construct-registry entries; declared reference group; validated-measurement status; FeedbackPolicy compatibility with LEARNER
qualification_gates.evidence: construct registry entries; declared-group record; validated-measurement status; LEARNER FeedbackPolicy declaration

qualification_rule: O2 (diagnostic_only) progresses only when G1-G7 ALL pass; any failed or missing gate means O1 research_only default; displayable additionally requires the D-08 display-policy qualification; gate records versioned with artifact; re-qualification per artifact version
fail_closed_rules: F2 qualification incomplete/missing/stale => O1; never inferred
F3 unknown artifact/corpus/feature/group, wrong hash, corrupt resource => unavailable
F4 FeatureSetVersion mismatch => UNAVAILABLE, never best-effort comparable (I3)
F5 fallback always disclosed; silent widening forbidden (I4)
F6 fallback-analyzer features and cross-version comparisons => INVALID
F7 banned vocabulary or risky ability phrases => INVALID (explicit prohibition text exempted)
F8 no LLM computation of corpus statistics (I5)
F9 no learner-facing corpus content without Researcher decision + display policy + licensing/anonymization gate (D-08)
F10 no raw SWECCL path/handle through generic runtime/retrieval/Skill/MCP/UX/L2/ACAD/LEARNER pathways (ADR-06)
F11 no proficiency/mastery/ability/learning-gain/CEFR claims; no causal/transfer claims; no cross-learner comparison
F12 no circular use of the 270 scored block; no score fields; partitions never split duplicate groups
F13 no external redistribution, text export, or public release
F14 learner evidence families never merged; HISTORY_LIMITATION accompanies longitudinal output
F15 missingness never imputed; evaluation-unavailable never replaced by zero or inference
learner_input_requirements: 1 exposure-class envelope: exposure_class + learner_exposure fields on every artifact/result
2 admissibility record with status and reasons; reject artifacts without a record
3 epistemic-status fields L0-L3 with downgrade-only invariant
4 canonical claim templates; verified-slot wording only (I5)
5 construct registry entries + declared reference group + validated-measurement gate
6 FeedbackPolicy compatibility declaration (policy_id/version, gate rules, priority limits, evidence-eligibility, no-priority semantics, claims constraints)
7 versioned consumption: same FeatureSetVersion both sides; cross-version rejected
10 explicit failure/unavailable semantics; no silent defaults
exclusions: textual/reconstructive derivatives (excerpts, quotations, examples, paraphrases, near-verbatim reproductions, example indices)
proficiency/mastery/learning-gain claims; normative labels; rankings; outcome claims
product code changes (app code, tests, persistence, API routes, composition root)
raw corpus access changes (CORPUS-owned, read-only, Goal-scoped)

artifact_classification.notes: internal descriptive reporting; contract/design only; no raw text, no excerpts
machine-checkable contract mirror + artifact-class register for this Goal
goal handoff report; internal descriptive reporting
structured executor handoff for Program Control

classification_rule: No WU-D artifact may be classified TEXTUAL/RECONSTRUCTIVE DERIVATIVE; any future WU-D artifact not listed here fails closed until classified and re-reviewed
notes: Contract/design only. displayable is defined but unpopulated (no display policy exists; learner-facing corpus content FAIL-CLOSED per D-08/licensing review). WU-D diagnostic computation remains gated on LEARNER consumption (LEARNER WAIT) and open Researcher decisions D4/D8/D12.
